title: The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion

abstractEnglish: We prove the Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion: for every free ultrafilter on ℕ, a nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra absorbs the Jiang–Su algebra if and only if its norm central-sequence algebra has no characters. We also prove that the infinite minimal tensor power of every nonzero unital separable complex C∗-algebra without characters is $`\mathcal Z`$-stable and contains a unital copy of $`\mathcal Z`$.
